comparison.objective: Pick ripe tomatoes at the stem knuckle while leaving unripe fruit and the plant undamaged.
comparison.physical_skill: Ripeness-based selection, gentle fruit support, localized stem/knuckle separation, and clutter-aware extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Only ripe target tomatoes are detached at the prescribed joint and collected without bruising, dropping, or plant damage.
comparison.reason: Although both create a controlled separation, tomato harvesting tests selective compliant produce detachment, not tool-driven notch fracture or tiny metal-fragment recovery.
